description: Usage, cost, quota and health for CLIProxyAPI, from cpa-usage-exporter's Prometheus sink.

panels.title: 5-Hour Window Used
panels.description: Share of the rolling 5-hour subscription window consumed, from the provider quota endpoint.

panels.title: 7-Day Window Used
panels.description: Share of the rolling 7-day subscription window consumed.

panels.title: 7-Day Projected at Reset
panels.description: Current burn rate extrapolated to the window reset. Above 100% the account is on track to exhaust its 7-day quota early.

panels.title: Reset Credits Available
panels.description: Rate-limit reset credits the provider still grants this period.

panels.title: Accounts Down
panels.description: Credentials currently disabled or unavailable for routing.

panels.title: Active Limits
panels.description: Provider-reported limits and their severity.

panels.title: Spend vs Cap
panels.description: Spend consumed against the provider-reported cap.

panels.title: Estimated Spend (range)
panels.description: Estimated cost of all traffic in the selected range, from the configured model price map. Subscription traffic is not billed per token, so treat this as notional.

panels.title: Routing Distribution
panels.description: Which models traffic actually landed on over the selected range.

panels.title: Requests by Account
panels.description: Load spread across credentials. A lopsided distribution usually means the others are cooling down.

panels.title: Status-Code Breakdown
panels.description: Upstream HTTP status codes on failed requests. 429 means rate limiting, 5xx means provider trouble.

panels.title: Time to First Token p50 / p95
panels.description: Streaming responsiveness. Only requests that reported a TTFT are counted.

panels.title: Token Throughput by Kind
panels.description: Tokens per second by accounting kind. cached and cache_read describe the same read-hit pool.

panels.title: Cache-Hit Rate by Model
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens served from cache. Higher is cheaper and faster.

panels.title: Reasoning-Token Share
panels.description: Reasoning tokens as a share of output tokens.

panels.title: Unpriced Models
panels.description: Models with no entry in the price map. Their traffic is missing from every cost panel; add them to your price file.

panels.title: Account Health
panels.description: Per-credential routability and lifetime counters as reported by CLIProxyAPI since its last restart.

panels.title: Live Rate-Limit (from response headers)
panels.description: Utilization reported on upstream response headers of proxied requests. Updates on every request, unlike the polled quota gauges.

panels.title: Account Availability Timeline
panels.description: Drops to 0 while a credential is disabled, cooling down or otherwise unroutable.

panels.title: Exporter Health
panels.description: If a collector goes stale beyond CPA's queue retention window, usage records are being dropped before they can be read.

title: CLIProxyAPI Usage
